title: Frontiers: Sunny World
description: My style of minecraft, a new world, slightly different than original minecraft when I started playing.
body:
# Frontiers: Sunny World

Why I made this modpack;
I wanted others to feel happy, like when they were kids with sun hitting their face outside with their parents, playing with friends, siblings, and just having fun. Maybe some injuries happen, but it always helped you learn.

What this modpack is about;
I know, I know. Create is in here, specifically "Create Fly" a port of Create that works with minor versions. Some may hate it, Some may not. There is thousands of modpacks for you to choose. Never limit yourself here.

I utilize "Tectonic" + "Blooming Biosphere" hand-in-hand to give you a world that is cinematic, yet not a slam of custom trees, and such. There is no modded biomes that are crazy blue, pink, maybe even just black. I want it natural.

There is a plethora of performance mods, and a shader mod in here for you.
I know some may not have a PC like mine,
i9-14900KF and RX 7900 XTX, but with Shaders (modpack built in with Mellow Shaders with Dynamic Lighting) and a 4k monitor, it runs on a stable 160 fps. (I do limit my fps to my monitor Hz rate. Prevents ruining your screen, you should too!)

This modpack I made can be played with friends, maybe a community server, it has a shop, "coins" from bronze to gold (or copper to gold), no recipes in them, so you can make it so they can get it from admin shops, or add a custom recipe.

Currently this modpack IS NOT configured, or setup properly, this is just a first version of getting it onto modrinth, there will and can be breaking changes, always create a backup before updating.


This description is susceptible to change.
All mods are not owned by me, all mods are located from within Modrinth.
Logo is not owned by me, will be changed once a proper logo is made.
